name: manual_73bcc8
claim: GitHub Actions pull_request checkout leaves HEAD at a synthetic server-side test-merge commit, not the PR branch tip — audit ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} for attribution/author checks, never HEAD, or a clean PR gets falsely flagged for an author it never actually had.

decisions.notes: PT/orama PR #190's Git hygiene CI failed on the PR author's registered GitHub account email as bad_author even though every real commit on the branch was authored by the approved (non-owner-gmail) git identity. Root cause: actions/checkout on pull_request events checks out refs/pull/N/merge, and that synthetic merge commit's author is synthesized server-side from the PR author's GitHub account email, unrelated to any git identity used on the branch. Fixed by auditing github.event.pull_request.head.sha instead of HEAD in the CI workflow.
